baseline_performance.caption: Per-baseline performance with uncertainty and calibration states.
baseline_performance.claim_neutral_interpretation: Reports proper scores, bootstrap CIs, and calibration feasibility for the fixed baseline suite. B0's INFEASIBLE calibration is a derived state. No winning-model claim.

cohort_roles.caption: Cohort construction and role assignment.
cohort_roles.claim_neutral_interpretation: Descriptive cohort accounting; the partition is exhaustive and disjoint (1573+357+430+2 = 2362) and roles are outcome-independent. No performance claim.

endpoint_threshold_sensitivity.caption: Endpoint threshold sensitivity.
endpoint_threshold_sensitivity.claim_neutral_interpretation: Shows the endpoint is not a single-grid artifact; prevalence and probe scores move smoothly across 5.5/6.0/6.5. No model-superiority claim.

exclusions_deviations.caption: Protocol decisions affecting interpretation.
exclusions_deviations.claim_neutral_interpretation: Explains excluded comparators and records, the lack of an equivalence claim, integrity bookkeeping, and interpretation of the near-zero split comparison.

leakage_gap.caption: Leakage-inflation across split schemes.
leakage_gap.claim_neutral_interpretation: Quantifies naive-vs-grouped split optimism for a fixed diagnostic model. The gap is near zero and slightly reversed, so it is reported as a null result rather than a gain.

pairwise_matrix.caption: Full pairwise ranking-stability matrix.
pairwise_matrix.claim_neutral_interpretation: Complete directional stability for every eligible pair. Equivalent class not asserted (no registered margin). Reinforces no-winning-model; overturns no headline.

reproducibility_manifest.caption: Data and reproducibility manifest.
reproducibility_manifest.claim_neutral_interpretation: Provenance and integrity anchors (hashes, single token, environment pins, licences). Establishes reproducibility, makes no performance claim.

slices.caption: Temporal and geographic transport slices.
slices.claim_neutral_interpretation: Descriptive per-slice probe Brier/AUROC. Geographic cells are single-source transport checks, not cross-system generalization claims.
